title: A public idempotency identifier matched the generic API key rule
symptom: The GitHub secret scan reported one generic API key finding in the dogfood intake fixture.
impact: The pull request was blocked even though the value was a public deterministic identifier rather than a credential.

root_cause.statement: The generic rule combined a key-like field name with an entropy-bearing example value and could not infer that the value was non-secret.

solution_options.description: Ignore only the reviewed historical finding by its commit, path, rule, and line fingerprint.
tradeoffs: Fingerprint must be maintained if history is rewritten

solution_options.description: Extend the default Gitleaks configuration with a path-and-line regex allowlist for this fixture.
tradeoffs: A broader regex can suppress future real findings

checks: Manual classification confirmed no credential or personal data
GitHub secrets job passed with default scanning intact

prevention: Use exact finding fingerprints instead of disabling generic rules
Never classify a scanner hit as false positive without inspecting the value and context

checks: The record contains no detected value, credential, personal data, customer identity, raw confidential log, or proprietary payload.

requirements: Security reviewer confirms the matched value is non-secret
